# looot-action

> GitHub Action: run one looot operation (email find, SERP, enrichment) and get the result as JSON. Pay per call.

looot is one key and one prepaid balance for 2,500+ data API endpoints from 90+ providers. The agent searches the catalog, sees the price before it runs, and pays per call.

## Install

- Remote MCP server: `claude mcp add --transport http looot https://api.looot.ai/mcp`
- This repo: uses: loootai/looot-action@v0.1.0

## Links

- Docs: https://docs.looot.ai
- Pricing: prepaid balance (top up from $5), charged per call, failed calls are free
- Recipes: https://github.com/loootai/awesome-looot-use-cases
- GTM tools list: https://github.com/loootai/awesome-gtm
